one_liner: Gladly offers a REST API with token-based Basic Auth and optional OAuth, plus an unofficial MCP server.
gating_notes: Requires an API token; sandbox available via CSM or support; OAuth optional via third‑party MCP.
oauth_details: OAuth2 is supported through third‑party MCP servers (e.g., Cotlet).
